note: Superior National Forest (Tofte district) rustic campground on 40-acre Hogback Lake, with a boat launch on the northeast shore, an accessible fishing pier and a day-use picnic area. Pull-in sites not designed for RVs, all three longer than 21 ft. A 6-mile trail along the ridges links Hogback, Canal, Lupus, Scarp, Mound and Steer lakes and five backcountry sites (boat, canoe or foot only). --Claude
